name: open-blank-pdf
expr: (async () => { const d = await PDFLib.PDFDocument.create(); d.addPage([595, 842]); const b = await d.save(); await ZT.openB64(ZT.b64(b), 'bat.pdf'); return 'opened:' + ZT.state().pages; })()

name: battery-pen-6-small-strokes
expr: (async () => { ZT.setTool('pen'); const R = ZT.pageRect(0), cs = R.cssScale, ic = document.querySelector('.pv[data-i="0"] .ic'); const mk = (type, x, y, id) => new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerType: 'pen', pointerId: id, isPrimary: true, pressure: 0.42, clientX: R.left + x * cs, clientY: R.top + y * cs, buttons: type === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1 }); const log = []; for (let s = 0; s < 6; s++) { const x0 = 180 + s * 46, y0 = 160 + (s % 2) * 30; const t0 = performance.now(); ic.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', x0, y0, 100 + s)); for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', x0 + i * 8, y0 + i * 5, 100 + s)); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', x0 + 26, y0 + 16, 100 + s)); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 130)); log.push({ s: s, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), strokes: ZT.state().strokes, tool: ZT.state().tool }); } return JSON.stringify({ log: log, ink: ZT.inkStats(0) }); })()

name: battery-hl-3-strokes
expr: (async () => { ZT.setTool('hl'); const R = ZT.pageRect(0), cs = R.cssScale, ic = document.querySelector('.pv[data-i="0"] .ic'); const mk = (type, x, y, id) => new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerType: 'pen', pointerId: id, isPrimary: true, pressure: 0.3, clientX: R.left + x * cs, clientY: R.top + y * cs, buttons: type === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1 }); const log = []; for (let s = 0; s < 3; s++) { const x0 = 180, y0 = 420 + s * 26; ic.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', x0, y0, 200 + s)); for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', x0 + i * 40, y0, 200 + s)); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', x0 + 170, y0, 200 + s)); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 140)); log.push({ s: s, strokes: ZT.state().strokes, tool: ZT.state().tool }); } return JSON.stringify({ log: log }); })()

name: lasso-shapes-battery
expr: (async () => { ZT.setTool('marquee'); const R = ZT.pageRect(0), cs = R.cssScale, ic = document.querySelector('.pv[data-i="0"] .ic'); const mk = (type, x, y, id) => new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerType: 'pen', pointerId: id, isPrimary: true, pressure: 0.4, clientX: R.left + x * cs, clientY: R.top + y * cs, buttons: type === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1 }); ic.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', 150, 120, 300)); const seq = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) seq.push([150 + i * 32, 120]); for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) seq.push([470, 120 + i * 40]); for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) seq.push([470 - i * 32, 520]); for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) seq.push([150, 520 - i * 40]); seq.forEach(q => window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', q[0], q[1], 300))); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', 150, 120, 300)); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 150)); const before = ZT.docStore(); const r0 = JSON.stringify(before); ic.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', 300, 300, 301)); for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', 300 + i * 5, 300, 301)); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', 360, 300, 301)); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 250)); const after = ZT.docStore(); let shapeMoved = false; try { for (const k in after.pages) { for (const st of after.pages[k].s) { if (st.t === 'g') { const old = before.pages[k].s.find(o => o.t === 'g'); if (old && old.pts.join(',') !== st.pts.join(',') && st.pts.every(v => isFinite(v))) shapeMoved = true; } } } } catch (e) {} return JSON.stringify({ shapeMoved: shapeMoved, allFinite: !JSON.stringify(after).includes('null'), tool: ZT.state().tool }); })()
